debrief db-021

row 4: t-h-e a-c-t-o-r e-x-p-l-o-i-t-e-d s-e-s-s-i-o-n j-s o-n t-o-k-e-n-s to t-a-k-e o-v-e-r g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d a-c-c-o-u-n-t-s, i-n-t-e-r-c-e-p-t-i-n-g a-u-t-h-o-r-i-z-a-t-i-o-n r-e-s-p-o-n-s-e-s in t-h-e p-l-a-y-w-r-i-g-h-t, b-e-f-o-r-e c-l-i-e-n-t-s c-o-u-l-d r-e-a-c-h t-h-e-m
row 5: a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d a n-e-t-w-o-r-k o-f c-o-m-p-r-o-m-i-s-e-d s-e-r-v-e-r-s to h-o-s-t f-a-k-e s-h-o-p-p-i-n-g p-a-g-e-s, u-s-i-n-g s-s-l c-e-r-t-i-f-i-c-a-t-e-s to a-p-p-e-a-r l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e, e-v-a-d-i-n-g f-i-r-e-w-a-l-l d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n by e-n-c-r-y-p-t-i-n-g a-l-l t-r-a-f-f-i-c
row 6: t-h-e a-c-t-o-r a-b-u-s-e-d t-h-e m-o-b-i-l-e a-p-p's a-p-i to b-u-l-k p-u-r-c-h-a-s-e d-i-g-i-t-a-l g-o-o-d-s, u-s-i-n-g a-u-t-o-m-a-t-e-d p-r-o-c-e-s-s to b-y-p-a-s e p-a-y-m-e-n-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n, c-o-n-v-e-r-t-i-n-g g-i-f-t-c-a-r-d b-a-l-a-n-c-e-s to c-a-s-h-e-q-u-i-v-a-l-e-n-t
